name: SQLite
description: A SQLite database file. SQLite has no databases or schemas to walk, so the hierarchy is empty and tables sit directly under the source. Opened with query_only, so nothing can be written.

version.sql: select sqlite_version() as version, 'SQLite ' || sqlite_version() as banner

test.sql: select sqlite_version() as version, (select count(*) from sqlite_master where type = 'table') as tables

source.sql: select 'SQLite' as product, sqlite_version() as version, 'SQLite ' || sqlite_version() as banner

sql: select m.name as name, m.type as type, case when m.type = 'view' then m.sql end as definition
where m.type in ('table', 'view') and m.name not like 'sqlite\_%' escape '\'
select m.name as dataset, p.cid + 1 as ordinal, p.name as name, p.type as data_type,
case when p."notnull" = 1 or p.pk > 0 then 0 else 1 end as nullable,
p.dflt_value as default_value, case when p.hidden in (2, 3) then 1 else 0 end as is_generated
select m.name as dataset, 'pk_' || m.name as name, 'primary_key' as type, p.name as columns, p.pk as seq
where m.type = 'table' and m.name in ({{datasets}}) and p.pk > 0
select m.name as dataset, il.name as name, 'unique' as type, ii.name as columns, ii.seqno as seq
from sqlite_master m, pragma_index_list(m.name) il, pragma_index_info(il.name) ii
where m.type = 'table' and m.name in ({{datasets}}) and il.origin = 'u'
select m.name as dataset, 'fk_' || m.name || '_' || f.id as name, 'foreign_key' as type,
f."from" as columns, f."table" as ref_dataset, f."to" as ref_columns, f.seq as seq
select m.name as dataset, il.name as name, il."unique" as is_unique,
case when il.origin = 'pk' then 1 else 0 end as is_primary, ii.name as columns, ii.seqno as seq,
from sqlite_master m, pragma_index_list(m.name) il, pragma_index_info(il.name) ii
left join sqlite_master s on s.type = 'index' and s.name = il.name
